flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/agencies/toppan/upload/{jobs/ToppanLettersGeneratorJob, jobs/ToppanUploadJob, helpers/ToppanUploadHelper, models/ToppanStage}, framework/schedulers/ToppanUploadJobsScheduler, framework/controllers/ToppanUnifiedController, crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsValidOffenceNotice/OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository (findToppanNoticesForStage, findNoticesForMhaNricUpload), framework/services/agencyFileExchange/AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl, framework/services/comcryptSftpBlob/helper/ComcryptUploadProcessor, framework/workflows/furnish_processing/helpers/FurnishApprovalHelper, framework/workflows/agencies/mha/download/helpers/MhaNricDownloadHelper, framework/workflows/datahiveuenfin/services/DataHiveUenFinService, properties cron-schedules-prod and application-prod. Other repos (ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi): no related code. The stale copy ocmsadminprivateapi/cronservice/ is not used as evidence
note: Status 'Demo paid (50% of 75%)'; demo_remark: SFTP, Code Split, SFTP permission for the api App Service (cannot verify from repo). There is no flow deck. 'Hirer' is read as an offender with owner_driver_indicator H: after furnish it enters RD1 -> RD2 -> RR3 (FurnishApprovalHelper.java:644-652; ToppanStage.java:19-21) and OCMS-DF-2026-170 says 'RR3 for hirers / DR3 for drivers', so the hirer's 3rd letter = stage RR3, using the same Toppan code as OCMS12.17 (owner), and the fits are kept equal. A fixed-width data file is built, goes to blob and then COMCRYPT (not a PDF; the PDF is made by the vendor, cannot verify from repo). Three things limit the claim: (1) the daily letter generation does not run because the call in ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:118 is commented out, only through POST /toppan/generate-letters; (2) application-prod.properties:86 sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan blocks the upload to the Toppan SFTP and the stage still advances without delivery (OCMS-DF-2026-192 Ready to UAT; OCMS-DF-2026-170 Closed); (3) a hirer who only has a furnished_mail address may lose letter_address after the RD1 letter (step 2, [Medium confidence]). The real server property values cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Claim partially. Building the RR3 data file and the blob + COMCRYPT flow exist in code, but the daily generation is commented out, the upload to the Toppan SFTP is blocked by config, and the stage advances without delivery. Ask URA to confirm when the Toppan block is lifted and the daily generation is switched on, and test one hirer who only has a furnished_mail address through to RR3

steps.step: Hirer notices that are due at stage RR3 are selected for the 3rd letter reminder
steps.detail: The story says 'hirer'. After furnish, the hirer is set as offender and the notice enters RD1 (FurnishApprovalHelper.java:644-652), then RD1 -> RD2 -> RR3 (ToppanStage.java:19-21). Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-170 (Closed) says 'RR3 for hirers / DR3 for drivers', so the hirer's 3rd letter = stage RR3. For RR3, getValidOffenceNoticesOptimized (ToppanUploadJob.java:248) calls findToppanNoticesForStage: next_processing_stage = RR3, next_processing_date <= today, suspension_type NULL, offender_indicator Y, an_flag not Y (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:583-614). The query does not tell owner/hirer/driver apart; only offender_indicator Y decides, same as OCMS12.17. Military/Diplomatic vehicles are excluded and given PS-MID/PS-DIP (ToppanUploadHelper.java:1974-1995) and notices without letter_address Y are filtered out (ToppanUploadJob.java:266). Appendix C Annex 1A (special vehicle/ID type) is not in the repo. The 00:15 schedule (process_dayend_jobs) is enabled=true in PROD (cron-schedules-prod.properties:61-62), but the call toppanLettersGeneratorService.executeJob() in ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:118 is commented out, so letter generation only runs through the manual trigger POST /toppan/generate-letters (ToppanUnifiedController.java:34-40). Rated Sebagian, same as OCMS12.17.

steps.step: The letter uses the hirer's latest particulars from the checks (name and address)
steps.detail: The name comes from onod.name (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:595) and the address from the owner_driver_addr row flagged letter_address Y (ToppanUploadHelper.java:2151-2165, 2200-2240), then is written to the file (AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl.java:648-690). The particulars check for individual hirers (NRIC) is done by the MHA job, which includes RR3 and is enabled=true in PROD (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:556-581; cron-schedules-prod.properties:105-106); for company hirers it goes through the DataHive UEN job, which is off in PROD (cron.mhadownload.uenfin.enabled=false, cron-schedules-prod.properties:52). The content of the OCMS8 checks is not re-traced here. But a new address from MHA only becomes letter_address when the notice has no address flagged Y yet (MhaNricDownloadHelper.java:2321-2328; DataHiveUenFinService.java:1736-1775), so 'latest' is not guaranteed. One thing to watch out for with hirers: the furnish result is stored as a furnished_mail address with letter_address Y (FurnishApprovalHelper.java:627-634), but after each letter is sent resetLetterAddressAfterToppan always clears letter_address and only sets it again if mha_reg -> lta_reg -> lta_mail exists (ToppanUploadHelper.java:467-468, 494-522); furnished_mail is not in that chain. A hirer who only has furnished_mail (for example FIN/passport with no MHA result) risks losing letter_address after the RD1 letter, then the notice is filtered out at ToppanUploadJob.java:266 and gets no RD2/RR3 letter. This is a finding from reading the code, not proven with data [Medium confidence].

steps.step: OCMS builds the 3rd letter data file for the vendor (Toppan)
steps.detail: The file is named URA-DPT-RR3-D1-yyyyMMddHHmmss (ToppanUploadJob.java:279-281) and its content is built by createToppanRequestFileContent: one 719-character header, one 719-character detail line per notice (letter date, notice no, name, address, vehicle no, place, rule) sorted by postal code, with the NRIC column deliberately left blank (AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl.java:564-600, 648-690). The story says 'PDF/data files'; what OCMS builds for RR3 is a data file, the PDF is made by the vendor (cannot verify from repo). OCMS only builds PDFs for stage ANL (ToppanUploadJob.java:323-345). Same fit as OCMS12.17.

steps.step: The file is sent to the vendor through SFTP (via blob and COMCRYPT encryption)
steps.detail: The file is uploaded to blob (ToppanUploadJob.java:314), then OCMS requests a COMCRYPT token for encryption (ToppanUploadJob.java:349-356); the callback encrypts and uploads to the Toppan SFTP. But in PROD application-prod.properties:86 sets sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan and ComcryptUploadProcessor throws SftpDisabledException for that server (ComcryptUploadProcessor.java:195-208). So by repo configuration the RR3 file does not reach the Toppan SFTP in PROD (dev and uat are the same). The properties comment says this block was added for OCMS-DF-2026-170 (Closed); its impact is discussed in OCMS-DF-2026-192 (Ready to UAT). The real PROD server value and the SFTP permission for the App Service (demo_remark) cannot verify from repo. Same fit as OCMS12.17.

steps.step: The notice is marked as sent: the stage moves on from RR3 after the file is delivered
steps.detail: The stage only advances after delivery to the SFTP is confirmed (OCMS-DEV-2026-199) through updateProcessingStage; last_processing_stage is set to RR3 and the next stage comes from ocms_stage_map with fallback RR3 -> CPC (ToppanUploadHelper.java:312, 1337-1362, 1514-1524, 1810-1830). But when Toppan is blocked by config, the gate is bypassed and the stage still advances (ToppanUploadJob.java:424-444): the notice counts as sent although the file never reached the vendor. This is what OCMS-DF-2026-192 (Ready to UAT, not final) discusses. If the PROD config equals the repo, the hirer moves to CPC without a letter reaching the vendor; whether another manual process exists cannot verify from repo. Same fit as OCMS12.17.
